notes.title: God of Riffs 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 1.0.4 has just been released. This update adds some accessibility features and also lays groundwork for some future features.

Framework Updates
First up, the framework additions - Our audio backend has been overhauled to now support FMOD. While current gameplay is unaffected, this will allow us to support a whole bunch of new, kick-ass audio effects in the future, and especially as we continue work on "Battle for the Metalverse!", our Story Mode.

Enemy Updates
Skulls now have attack animations! They swoop up to take a bite at you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/2d19bba5ee0950785e572a71ee457990777b8cee.gif

Accessibility Updates
Late last year, we showed the game off at PAX West, and gained a lot of feedback on how to move forward. one of the biggest requests for for some more accessibility features, and we're happy to provide them to help metalheads of all abilities rock out and smash some skulls!

Accessibility features added in this update include:

 Vivid Mode
Height Adjust


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/43324b8f3bf232e744c8ba2cdd69e2e00812d8fd.png
Vivid Mode
This changes the colors of the enemies and your axes from Red, Blue and Yellow to Orange, Cyan, and White. This can be useful for players with most types of color blindness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/77ec48a89b5654e3afbe4139adb53cc60f5cb987.png
Height Adjust
At PAX, some people had their kids try and play God of Riffs. While we do recommend limiting the game to players over the age of 13, this did make us realise our game wasn't optimized for shorter players. 
We've added a height adjustment option, so that seated, shorter, or younger players can now dial in a comfortable height for skull-smashing! Try setting it to max while standing up to play as a giant! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/db4d0ebafbb5cca94b3ecc8e77dc329d95485862.png

As always, thank you for your support! Let us know if you have any questions or thoughts. Look forward to the upcoming audio and story mode updates! Join our Discord and follow our Twitter to stay posted!

notes.title: GOD OF RIFFS IS READY TO ROCK!
notes.content:
Hey, Metalheads!

Grab your axes - God of Riffs has finally come out of Early Access on Steam, and we’re ready to ROCK!

In a moment of dire need, the metal gods call out for a fearless champion to embark on a rhythmic journey into the domain of the Lord of Silence. Answer their cries and brave forth to slash skeleton armies to a metal beat and save humanity from a sad, rhythmless afterlife. 

Here’s some of the exciting features we’ve added since the last Early Access update:


 An updated, slicker UI - for smoother navigation
 Massively increased performance - so you can keep on rockin’
 Improved haptics on Meta Quest controllers - feel the buzz
 Tutorial level to train new players to rock god status!
 Updated ranking system incentivising smashing skeletons over precise hit timing (and a leaderboard reset!) - the harder you rock, the more you win
 55 total achievements - so you can start rackin’ them up
 6 additional new songs (10 Total) including: 
 The full original soundtrack from BMG
 “Lay To Waste” by Frank Klepacki and The Tiberian Sons
 ‘Money Money’ by Shota Nakama, from the latest game by SWERY’s White Owls, ‘The Good Life’!



We’ve come a long, long way since we entered Early Access, but just because we’ve hit “1.0” doesn’t mean we’re done.. In fact, it's just the start of the journey for God of Riffs!

Here’s a look at what’s coming soon:


Battle For the Metalverse - God Of Riffs’ Story Mode!
Additional tracks including ‘Fly Away’ by GloryHammer, licensed songs from US and Australian Metal bands and collaborations with indie games!
More original tracks!
Release on Meta Quest App Lab!
RiffMapper Beta Public Launch - an exclusive tool for creating and importing your own custom songs (PC Only)

As always, if you find any issues with any part of the game, feel free to let us know on our discord, or on twitter @bossmusicgames.

Till next time,
Keep Shredding, And see you in the Metalverse!!

notes.title: God Of Riffs 0.8.3.1
notes.content:
Hey, Metalheads!

This is a small update to fix a few bugs, and implement some long awaited backend and framework-level updates to support some upcoming major game features coming in the Upcoming 0.8.4 major patch.


Changelog:


 Updated our base VR framework to OpenXR, allowing for much faster development cycles as we no longer have to juggle multiple XR rigs for each platform
 A bunch of UI Tweaks and updates, such as fixes for Song Previews, and some Tweaks to button borders and Leaderboard entry text
 Weapon Calibration should be far more stable
 Pausing has been reworked, and now detects Input from the Standard Menu Button, System menu button, and Proximity Sensor input! (Please note: Proximity sensor support does not currently work on Vive/Index, we're working on a solution for this, and it should hopefully be in by 0.8.4)
 Graphics Performance optimization across the board, allowing play on lower-end devices
 Some minor Graphics tweaks in gameplay as we tune in our final look


As always, If you have any issues with the game, Bugs to report, want to share a particularly hype session, or just want to chill with us, we're available on our Discord, or our Twitter!

notes.title: God Of Riffs - 0.8.1 Patch notes
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who's joined the journey so far, and provided their feedback!
We've taken all of it into account, and have spent the last week squashing most, if not all of the most egregious bugs. :)


Changelog:

 Collision Detection reworked - If you're still missing notes, that's on you! :)
 SteamVR poses fixed for Vive, Index, and WMR controllers (no more upside down hands!)
 WMR Controller support in SteamVR
 Pause system reworked - Pausing the game should perform as intended now
 Lots of backend fixes to improve performance (Hello, Unity 2020.3.15!)
 Elemental creatures in each level should be a bit more reactive...
 Loading screens should be (Mostly) Aligned now, no more loading bars off to the left
 Hitting Powerup notes should vibrate on the controller that hit it, instead of on both controllers
 Lots of Ragdoll physics glitches have been fixed (Skulls and skeletons shouldn't explode so readily)
 Dungeon has been removed from the stage rotation for now (Don't worry, it'll be back before you know it and look better than ever!)



As always, if you find any issues with any part of the game, feel free to let us know on our Discord Server, or on Twitter @bossmusicgames.


Till next time,
Keep Shredding!

notes.title: God of Riffs Blog: Gameplay Features
notes.content:
Hey Skeleton Slashers!

We're just ONE WEEK away from the release of God of Riffs on July 27th! Wow!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/310981b9a3f3fb19905cc5d69bbe127ab6da8cff.png

We're really excited to get the game into your hands and get your feedback. One of the things that we're excited about, and plan to continue iterating on, is making sure the gameplay mechanics feel "right" when playing GoR. Below are some of our thoughts detailing the gameplay features and mechanics of God of Riffs. Let's get to it.

Modifiers:
Before selecting your track to slay, you can select from a variety of modifiers that will affect your gameplay. These include:

 No Fail (Invincibility)
 Instant Death (One miss, and you're dead)
 Strong Arms (Your swings require less force)
 Weak Arms (Your swings require more force)
 Hidden Enemies (Enemies will only appear when they are near)
 Random Enemies (Enemies will switch up their attack formations)
 Change Enemy Speed (Your enemies will come at you at a speed of your choosing)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/3ffb93971944805c8b4f132f97617bb1acf37842.jpg

We plan on adding more modifiers in the future! Are there any special requests you'd like to see? We're all ears. 👂👂👂👂👂👂

Combo System:

Slashing Skeletons without missing deserves a reward. Along with your streak, you'll contribute to your combo multiplier, which will help you climb up the leaderboards.

Enemy Colors:

Your enemies will come at you in a variety of three colors: Red, Blue, and Gold. Smash enemies with your axe(s) of their corresponding color to destroy them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/b7a5b83da8ccf84a57198bd39896ea52a63ccaff.png

The Gold enemies however, can be hit with both axes. Hitting a Gold enemy will supercharge your axes and, when the time is right, you can execute Rage Mode!

Rage Mode/Power Up:

To execute Rage Mode, hit Golden Enemies with your axes. After hitting enough of them, raise an Axe to the kky and press the trigger button!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/3029a68e604e2d2e64e30616cbf536e1426e0742.gif

Rage mode causes your swings to be 8x more forceful than normal, and add 8 to your current combo multiplier! Use Rage during large enemy attacks to gain as many points as possible!

Spectator Mode:

We have full support for LIV Mixed Reality Capture, meaning you can smash skeletons with your own personal avatar, or even as yourself in Mixed Reality!  Grab LIV on Steam or at LIV.tv! Wahoo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/2b9c1538a8f04a9d2ed2e775c0c35f5aab1a0cc2.png

The Future:
We have many more ideas planned for how GoR will evolve as we get your feedback and move to version 1.0 (and beyond!) potentially including…:

 Played-Created Beatmaps for any audio
 More enemies! Maybe something a little, cold…
 More Base-game music!
 DLC Song Packs!
 Story Mode!
 Endless Mode!

God of Riffs will be available in just days, so please check out and wishlist us at heavymetalbeatsaber.com - Thanks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/a711b13833394c808e4988420a7eaf0c9e57ced2.gif

notes.title: Introducing God of Riffs!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/0257115bdde72ae7d1f9f76dac8ed20241458da2.png

What’s crankin’, metalheads?

Pleasure to meet ya, we’re VYERSOFT and Boss Music Games! We are made up of active VR gamers and enthusiasts, looking to contribute some games to the revolutionary platform of Virtual Reality.

We wanted to quickly say hi with this introductory post and also let you know about a game we’re publishing called God of Riffs, developed by Boss Music Games.

God of Riffs is a tribute to one of the last true passionate forms of music.. heavy friggin’ metal.

There’s no stairway to heaven for the God of Riffs. Instead, you must wield musical battle axes to thrash, smash, and slash incoming hellspawn in rhythmic melee combat fueled by screaming guitar solos and thunderous double bass pedals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/d47c77b76f2270a4739d6631ced5ca550d7f1ae8.gif
Starting on July 27th, for $4.99...

Slay swarms of undead skeletons — with fearsome ice giants, trolls, and more joining the armies of hell throughout Early Access — or face a dreary, metal-less afterlife.

Harder axe slashes earn more points, so bash your enemies’ skulls in (literally) with all your might to soar to the top of the leaderboards!

[previewyoutube=zlIIBMDtc5k;full][/previewyoutube]
Check out the GoR trailer for a sneak peek at what the game will play like:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/5e177b7de037527d9311d804f39bc60af36c8fad.png

We plan to debut more songs, modes, and accessibility options before the 1.0 launch later this year.

Early Access players unlock the full version of God of Riffs for $4.99 before the price increases when the game graduates to full release. Wow.. Savings!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574089/a711b13833394c808e4988420a7eaf0c9e57ced2.gif

If this seems gnarly, please consider doing some or all of the following:
Wishlist us on Steam! (here, duh)
Wishlist us!
Join our Discord!
Follow us on Medium!

God of Riffs, the rhythmic heavy metal slasher from publisher VYERSOFT (that’s us!) and developer Boss Music Games, sets the stage for battles against the undead when it launches onto Early Access on Tuesday, July 27 with support for Oculus and Steam. 

For more information, please visit the official website and Facebook page. Follow VYERSOFT on Twitter, Boss Music Games on Twitter and Instagram.

Thank you so much for reading and we can't wait to show you more God of Riffs, as well as some other cool VYERSOFT projects we've been working on!

- Team VYERSOFT and Boss Music Games

About VYERSOFT

VYERSOFT Corp. is a new publisher made up of game industry veterans who have worked on titles such as 2064: Read Only Memories, DAMN! and ToeJam and Earl: Back in the Groove! The team believes in bringing new unique gaming experiences using emerging technologies as a new, innovative medium.

About Boss Music Games

Boss Music Games is a group of crazy blokes that had the totally reasonable idea of starting an indie dev studio. Straight out of school…with limited funds…during a pandemic…from a city no one has heard of (Perth, by the way!). But through the power of persistence and the spirit of metal, they plan to rock the world with their VR projects.
